steps.content: This wave of monsters is more dangerous than the previous ones. Although EMP and Hella manage to repel them, they are inevitably left with various wounds.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: So... So much for that...
Hella wipes away the blood on her face with her sleeve. Her face is still pale, but she's bluffing to cover her fear.
However, EMP has been completely scared out of her wits. She holds her head in her hands and curls into a ball. Her eyes have no focus, and she's shivering and muttering.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Almost... Its tentacles almost poked through my neck...

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: It should have done just that!
Josh suddenly pushes EMP to the ground, and she lets out a muffled grunt.

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: Hahaha, look at you. One push, and you're on the ground. You're ruining the reputation of FAC!
He looks down at EMP and lets out a domineering laugh.

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: A little girl scared the crap out of you. You're dragging us down, you coward.

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: For real, you only bring us misfortune with that big mouth of yours. You should be left to feed the monsters.

steps.speaker: It's fine, no worries! I'm just surprised you actually showed up! And you know Miss Cabernet so well, too!
steps.content: **** you! Shut the hell up!
Hella has finally had enough of this. She flips him to the ground with her pipe, throwing him five meters away. She then crouches in front of EMP and holds her shoulders.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: EMP!!! Don't listen to him! Snap out of it!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: But I am a coward! This place... It's more frightening than Syndicate gangsters. I can't talk to the monsters, and all my self-protecting posturing and fawning doesn't work!
EMP shouts out and then slowly looks up at Hella. There's no amount of pride left on her face, and she even looks a bit pitiful.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: He's not wrong... Let's go back... Don't keep going... We really will die here...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: ...What are you talking about? I, the invincible Hella, is still here, and no one can hurt you!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Besides, even if you are a coward in the Syndicate. You survived, became a Sinner, and some kind of Backstreet Overlord, didn't you?!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Doesn't the Syndicate believe the law of t-the jingle or something? We both survived until now in the hellholes, and it's because we have our own powers!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: We may look like cowards, but we are the strong! We are survivors, winners of the Syndicate!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Well... You have a point, but... but...

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: There's no but! You can have all your buts after we find the Chief!
Hella reaches out and pulls Emp up from the ground.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Well, o-okay...

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: I-is this a joke...? You two are... Sinners?!
Josh stands behind Hella and EMP, looking horrified and helpless.

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Oh no... Nightingale said we should keep our identities a secret...

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Don't be afraid... Listen to me...
EMP raises her hands and tries to approach Josh, but he backs into a corner and starts swinging a sculpture piece he found on the ground.

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: Stay away!!! Monsters! You, get away from me!!!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: What the hell? Look who's the coward now? Think about it. When have we ever tried to harm you, all this way?

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: You... You are working with the monsters here, aren't you?!
Hella tries to calm him down, but Josh is too frightened to hear any of it. He howls hysterically, teetering on the brink of an emotional breakdown.

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: Argh!

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: Don't touch me! Don't touch me! Go and hunt someone else! Please! Let me go!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: No... We have to control him, or it's going to cause a scene...
Maybe Hella's words aroused his instinct for self-defense under extreme fear, Josh throws the plaster piece toward Hella and EMP.

steps.speaker: Josh
steps.content: I said stay away!!!
The two dodge out of the way, only to see a heavily mutated arm reaching out from the shadows behind them and grabbing the piece.
The sharp claw grips hard, and the plaster crumbles into powder.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: That... That's...
Several Corruptor monsters roam out of the shadows, baring their fangs. EMP is so shocked she falls onto the ground again.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Argh!!! Corrupted Sinners this time!! We're so dead!!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Stop howling! What's so scary about these guys?! I got you! A-and we can go to ${PlayerName}!

steps.speaker: Hella
steps.content: Get up! We are not fighting alone in the Syndicate anymore. Let's go get him!
steps.female_content: Get up! We are not fighting alone in the Syndicate anymore. Let's go get her!

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: You're right... Ahhhhhh!! That monster is c-c-closing in, argh!!!
EMP cries out, raises her bow, and shoots the leader Corruptor Sinner down with one blow.

steps.speaker: EMP
steps.content: Where are you, Chief! Help!!!
